name: Drop-weight egg topper ('Eierschalensollbruchstellenverursacher'); current example: Take2-Design "Clack" Eieröffner
manufacturer_brand: Generic device type; current example sold by Take2-Design (Germany). Photographed units: brand not identifiable.
what_it_does: A metal cap is placed on top of a boiled egg and a weighted ball on a rod is lifted and dropped, cracking a clean circular line so the top of the shell can be lifted off.
legitimate_use_audience: Soft-boiled-egg eaters (common at German breakfast); avoids shell splinters and, per one photographer, 'burned fingers'. Not an accessibility aid in any source seen.

sources.confirms: Manufacturer shop: 'Den Eierschalensollbruchstellenverursacher bringen Sie wie folgt zum Einsatz: Metallkappe auf´s gekochte Ei setzen, die Schlagkugel hochziehen und einfach fallen lassen.' Price 'ab 30,95 EUR'.
Commons description: instrument used to mark the top of cooked eggs so they can be cut and opened (photo of drop-ball type).
Major German retailer category page uses the name 'Eierschalensollbruchstellenverursacher' and distinguishes ball-weight (Kugelgewicht, ~24 cm) vs spring models.

brazil_availability: Egg-opener listings exist on Amazon.com.br (R$ 19,90-31,90, e.g. ASIN B0GTC7ZYHV), but whether they are the drop-ball type was NOT verified (the one product page opened did not describe the mechanism).
